notes: Local drafts stay under Git metadata and are not canonical truth.
Missing or empty protected_paths blocks every Mission Control write surface.
Local publish validates every operation against protected_paths and binds confirmation to draft_revision.
GitHub repository grants are the only access authority; Mission Control does not maintain a second roster, approval-role gate or writer credential.
GitHub authenticates the Builder over SSH (agent) or HTTPS (Git credential helper, e.g. Git Credential Manager); plaintext credentials in the remote URL are forbidden.
Publish creates one ordinary single-parent commit and one non-force fast-forward push to v3; GitHub rejects principals without live write access.
The changeset directories are read-only compatibility history for older deployments and are not part of the default local publish flow.
The Organization's former in-tree Mission Control layer was imported into this repository once (plan EX-0001); it is not read or written by the runtime.
All writes go to this repository-db data checkout.
Organization-owned Mission Control data of Lazurio Example Organization (fictional reference Organization).
The remote is LazurioExampleOrganization/mission-control-data on branch v3.
Do not store secrets or personal runtime state in Mission Control data.
